name: motion-ease-slowmo
title: SlowMo
description: Lướt nhanh vào, đi rất chậm qua đoạn giữa rồi tăng tốc ra; cho tiêu đề đi xuyên khung kiểu quay chậm.

moworks.author: moworks

options.graph: a canvas to draw the curve on (a teaching guide; none by default)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: SlowMo(0.7, 0.7) as one ease: the first 15 % of the time covers about 40 % of the distance (fast, easing into the slow part), the middle 70 % moves linearly through only about 21 % (value 0.35 + 0.3 p), the last 15 % covers the remaining ~40 %, accelerating out; 1200 ms. For titles passing through the frame; the key moment sits in the slow middle. Small demo approximates it with cubic-bezier(.1,.65,.9,.35). Params: duration (1.2 s) · linear: tỷ lệ đoạn chậm (0.7) · power (0.7).
